title: The same companion quest shows three contradictory completion states: 'Quest done: The Exile's Ledger' (Keeper Wren's Trust dialogue, The Keepers' Hall, Barrowmere), then later 'Quest closed: The Exile's Ledger — its asker's wish is past meeting' (finding the founding ledger, Hall of Ledgers, Marrowgate), and finally the end-game status screen lists it under 'Failed: The Exile's Ledger' — even though the underlying content (Vell's exiled royal blood) was fully and successfully resolved on-screen.
where: The Keepers' Hall (Barrowmere) / Hall of Ledgers (Marrowgate) / final status screen
